description: Compile a PBL document you wrote (pbl) or apply #id patch lines to an earlier compile (blueprintId + patch). No model is called: Picorn searches the curated asset libraries, measures text with the real fonts, lays out, reviews and renders. Returns blueprintId, errors/warnings with codes and fixes, the scene report + ASCII wireframe (exact boxes, colours, effects, search hits), the canonical source and an inline preview of every slide. Patches reuse the cached asset searches, so iterate with small patches until errors=0 and the preview is visually finished. Set preview:false for an even faster text-only check.

blueprintId.description: From an earlier compile, together with patch.

patch.description: Repair lines, e.g. "#title size=96 color=primary" or "#n12 delete".

pbl.description: Full PBL document starting with "pbl v1". Creates a new blueprintId.

preview.description: Render the inline preview. Default true.

name: picorn_blueprint_compile
title: Picorn Blueprint: compile, review and preview
